headerDisplay: Enter your Mitsubishi **Wi-Fi Control** app credentials to discover your units.

password.title: User Password
password.description: Password used on your Mitsubishi Wi-Fi Control app

dry.title: Enable Dry Mode (experimental)
dry.description: Dry mode is still in development and is subject to bugs.

outdoorTemperature.title: Expose Outdoor Temperature
outdoorTemperature.description: Expose the MELView outdoor temperature reading as a linked HomeKit temperature sensor when available.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often each unit refreshes its state from MELView. Commands update instantly, so this only catches changes made outside HomeKit (e.g. the wall remote). Higher values are gentler on the MELView API.
